I will not buy chemical fertilizer for this small plot because one bag costs too much and is more than this land needs. I will spread manure on it since it is my own land and manure costs nothing. I will plant the seed I kept from last season, and me and my family will pull the weeds by hand. We do not need to hire anyone for such a small piece, and the rain is enough so I will not irrigate.
